# Dr. Manu Gautam — Orthopaedic Surgery

> Public navigation and factual clinic information for Dr. Manu Gautam's website. Medical articles are educational, not a substitute for diagnosis or clinical care.

## Practice and locations

- Official website: https://drmanugautam.com/
- Doctor: Dr. Manu Gautam, MBBS, D-Ortho, DNB (Orthopedics)
- Training: MBBS (Government Medical College, Bellary); Diploma in Orthopaedics (Santosh Medical College, Ghaziabad); DNB Orthopaedics (Max Super Speciality Hospital, Shalimar Bagh, Delhi)
- Membership: Indian Orthopaedic Association
- Speciality: Orthopaedic surgery and joint care
- Noida consultation clinic: D-8, D Block, Sector 20, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301
- Noida clinic hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00–20:00; Sunday 11:00–13:00
- The Noida clinic has its own operation theatre: Dr. Manu Gautam consults and operates in Noida, and also operates at Dharamshila Narayana Superspeciality Hospital, New Delhi.
- Noida appointments: +91 9999770850
- Noida clinic on Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=15622916972718693117
- Delhi consultations: Dharamshila Narayana Superspeciality Hospital, Vasundhara Enclave, New Delhi 110096 (the hospital is a separate organisation)
- Delhi hospital contact: +91 9769761602
- Ghaziabad, Greater Noida, and Sector 104 Noida are patient catchment areas, not additional practice addresses.

## Verification and context

The website provides authored and medically reviewed patient education. Published articles and treatment pages include references to clinical guidance or medical studies where available. Treatment suitability and outcomes vary by the individual's diagnosis. Verify clinic attendance timings before visiting.

Older URLs on this domain (for example /best-orthopedic-doctor-in-ghaziabad/ or /replacement-surgeon-in-ghaziabad/) are retired and permanently redirect to the current pages above.
